newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche Bank down, large sell order seen.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Bank down, large sell order seen.

text.p: Shares in Germany's largest bank Deutsche Bank dropped against a stronger market on Tuesday, with traders confused by the fall, but saying there had probably been a large sell order from a foreign investor.
"There is no news out on the bank. We're all trying to work out what is going on," said one trader. "But it is allegedly a large sell order from a foreign address."
Deutsche was down 70 pfennigs, or almost one percent, at 69.60 marks, while the DAX index of 30 leading shares was stronger, up 12.01 points, or 0.45 percent, at 2,683.87.
Dealers said the fact that Deutsche Bank had fallen below the chart technical and psychological level of 70 marks was also a negative signal.
